posts.name: AXL

posts.description: Capture leads, close sales & onboard customers in one system: pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting & streaming, email, chat, CRM, telephony & AI calls. Give ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor access to lead context & 1,200+ sales & marketing actions via MCP.

posts.name: Deduplication
posts.tagline: Which Meaning Owns the Word?
posts.description: Bug used to mean an insect. Mouse, an animal. Token, a coin. Tech keeps borrowing words, and deduplication.tech measures which meaning is winning. 719 duplicated terms across 14 fields (AI, crypto, gaming, cloud and more). Each pair is scored with live Wikipedia pageviews: the original still owns it, it's contested, or the duplicate took over. Explore the word cloud, leaderboards and term pages. Free and open, by HackerNoon.

posts.name: NoMac

Billed per minute from prepaid credit, no subscription: a whole build costs a few cents.

posts.name: Archie
posts.tagline: Mac Screenshot Manager & Notch Shelf
posts.description: Archie — a small Mac app that keeps screenshots in your notch, ready to edit and drag wherever you need them.

posts.name: outages.live

posts.description: Check whether a provider is down before debugging your code. outages.live brings official status pages for cloud, AI, payments, and developer tools into one feed, refreshed every few minutes. Give your coding agent outage context over MCP, browse the live feed, or subscribe via RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, or Slack. Free, with no login or API key.

posts.name: Zigzag Browser
posts.tagline: The polished, native Mac browser for life after Arc
posts.description: A native Mac browser for people leaving Arc, with the sidebar and spaces you're used to. Built on WebKit, not Chromium, and that's the point: the whole app is 18 MB (Arc is 871). Switching takes a minute. One import brings over everything, so you're already logged in. Colored spaces you swipe between, split view, peek, Chrome extensions like 1Password and Tampermonkey, and ad blocking built-in Open source, no account, no AI. Nobody can shut it down.

posts.name: DocsAlot for customer support
posts.tagline: Slack and Discord bot that answers your customers questions
posts.description: DocsAlot can now answer common customers questions, in slack and discord, based on your existing knowledge-base

posts.name: Agent Clan
posts.tagline: Command your Claude Code and Codex agents with gestures
posts.description: Agent Clan puts your Claude Code and Codex agents on your screen as a 3D team you run with your hands. Make a fist and they appear. Pinch and pull toward one to pick it, then just say what you need. When an agent asks for permission, pull right to allow or left to deny. Circle anything on your screen to hand it over, or ask a leader and its crew splits the work. Hand tracking and voice run on your computer, and everything also works with a mouse. Free on Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Tilde 
posts.tagline: Finder replacement & file manager for mac
posts.description: Tilde is the native Finder replacement for Mac. Browse folders in custom split layouts, organise files by status or client with custom properties, restore tabs and layouts with saved workspaces, and too much more to list. Purchase once, no subscription.

posts.name: NotchIsland
posts.tagline: Free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch
posts.description: NotchIsland turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: a true-black surface that grows out of the notch when something is live (Now Playing, timers, AirPods battery, downloads, notifications) and disappears when nothing is. Hover for a readout; click for a shade with quick toggles, a timer, your next meeting with a Join button, a file Shelf and clipboard history. Option-Space opens a launcher with app search, calculator and unit conversion. Forever free, open source (MIT), macOS 13+.

posts.name: Textly
posts.tagline: Capture Text & Tables from Anywhere on Your Mac
posts.description: Stop retyping text and rebuilding tables. Textly lets you instantly capture text from anywhere on your Mac — even when you can't select or copy it. Extract tables from screenshots, PDFs, videos, and apps while keeping rows and columns intact. Export to CSV, Markdown, or TSV, translate text instantly, and revisit previous captures with clipboard history. Just select an area, capture, and get back to what matters.

posts.name: Keypause
posts.tagline: Turn off your Mac's keyboard while you clean it

posts.name: Memorias
posts.tagline: An AI biographer that turns your stories into a book

Memorias transcribes everything, maps the people, places and years into a life timeline, and assembles chapters in your own words. Nothing invented: every chapter is checked against what you actually said. Add your photos, then export EPUB, PDF or DOCX. Pay-per-use credits, no subscription.

posts.name: NotchX
posts.tagline: Turn your MacBook's notch into a hub for music and calls

posts.name: ReleaseStack

posts.name: Orbi

Orbi scores every idea against your own baseline, forecasts a post before you make it, and grades it after. Agents that know your niche and your brand plan, script, cut and publish from your footage.

posts.name: Riff Calendar

posts.tagline: Notes pinned to your Lock Screen, widgets and Dynamic Island
posts.description: Same name, different app: this launch is PinNote – Notes Always Visible (App Store ID 6809535973): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6809535973 The PinNote listed here from July 2 is another developer's app. PinNote puts text, photos, voice and video notes on your Lock Screen, Home Screen widgets, StandBy and Dynamic Island. Pin from Control Center, swipe to edit or delete. Reminders can bypass silent mode. The interface is available in 30 languages. Free, with in-app purchases.

posts.name: TemplaGem
posts.tagline: Smart prompt templates with dynamic variables for AI
posts.description: Browser extension for Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek. Insert variable-ready prompt templates with interactive {{variables}}, fluid Tab navigation, and offline-first cloud sync. Cloud sync is disabled for the moment but coming soon

posts.name: EmoTick
posts.tagline: Pursuing crazy, insane visuals: a tactile fidget clicker
posts.description: EmoTick is an emotional and fun tactile fidget toy for your eyes, fingertips, and ears. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT • Visual Dopamine: Colorful light bursts and glow. • Satisfying Sound & Touch: Clicks and vibrations that feel just like a real physical switch. • Unwind, Focus, Relax, and Recharge. • No ads, no sign-ins, works offline anytime, anywhere. • 3-day free trial. Keep it forever with a one-time purchase (no subscriptions).

posts.name: Invoke
posts.tagline: Integrated operating platform for AI Agents
posts.description: Give your AI agents the tools to get real work done. Connect your existing agents to the tools and workflows your team uses. Invoke manages permissions, approval gates, and execution tracking, so you can control what agents do across your systems without replacing your existing stack.

posts.name: FinFlow Desk Document Creator
posts.tagline: Create Invoices & Business Documents
posts.description: Create invoices, quotes, receipts, orders and VAT invoices online. Get two PDF exports daily without signing up, or five with a free account. Pro PDF exports are unlimited.

posts.name: Ocarina Guide Map AI
posts.tagline: Offline Zelda maps, collectibles, songs, and grounded AI
posts.description: An Ocarina of Time companion for iPhone and iPad: offline maps, collectible tracking, illustrated guides, song practice, a progress journal, and evidence-based AI help. Offline features are free; additional AI answers use an optional subscription. WIP.

posts.name: 9xSnap
posts.tagline: Screenshots & Clips for Windows, Mac & Linux
posts.description: Capture screenshots, save clips and record your screen on Windows, Mac and Linux. Free opens your 50 newest entries; Pro adds full history, editors and export.

posts.name: AIPICKS.CA
posts.tagline: AI Sports Picks & AI Betting Predictions for UFC, NHL. more
posts.description: AI sports picks: free and paid AI table tennis, UFC, NHL, NBA, NFL predictions with a public results ledger.

posts.name: trans2audio
posts.tagline: AI voice messages for business phone lines
posts.description: Create professional telephone greetings, IVR menus and announcements in minutes. Fill in a few details, pick a natural Google voice in English, Hindi and more, preview for free, and download MP3 or telephony-ready WAV (incl. 8 kHz) for your IVR/PBX. No subscription: pay per audio. Built for clinics, hotels, shops, startups and contact centres.

posts.name: Whatstir
posts.tagline: Explore YC startups by sector and the problems they solve
posts.description: Find which YC startups solve the problem you care about. Pick a sector, ask in plain English, and get answers that cite the companies behind them. Includes a sector treemap, company comparisons and daily data refresh. Open source, not affiliated with YC.

posts.name: Aisley
posts.tagline: Plan your whole wedding inside ChatGPT or Claude
posts.description: Plan your wedding inside ChatGPT or Claude. Aisley finds real venues, emails them from your Gmail once you confirm, reads the replies, chases quiet ones and keeps the budget. Works in the web app too. £10 a month per wedding, free trial, no card.

posts.name: Fire Extinguisher Management System
posts.tagline: FireXCheck is software that tracks fire safety assets
posts.description: Professional fire extinguisher inspection and compliance management software FireXCheck is software that tracks fire extinguisher inspections so you never fail an audit or miss a certificate again

posts.name: Apexly
posts.tagline: Custom domains for your SaaS customers in one API call
posts.description: Apexly is a custom domains API for B2B SaaS. Send one request with your customer's hostname; they add one DNS record on a hosted page that detects their DNS provider. Apexly verifies it from three resolvers, issues and renews the Let's Encrypt certificate, supports apex domains, and forwards traffic to your app with a signed request.

posts.name: Bicep Heart AI
posts.tagline: Turn Your Photo into an Arm-Heart Video
posts.description: Animate one adult portrait into a 7-second, 9:16 arm-heart video with generated instrumental music. Your photo guides the person and visible outfit. Choose Basic or Pro and review the credit quote before creating. Paid credits required; confirmed failed generations return credits. Face details, fingers and the heart shape may vary. Generation is temporarily unavailable; you can prepare a photo and review settings.

posts.name: Kleido
posts.tagline: Automotive key code lookup, jobs and invoices in one app
posts.description: From key code to invoice. Kleido helps automotive locksmiths convert supported codes to bittings, search known cuts, and find key blanks, Lishi tools and transponder references. Save jobs, keep customer details together and send invoices from your phone. Available on the web and Android in the U.S. Internet required; coverage varies by vehicle and key system. VIN scanning identifies the vehicle; it does not retrieve a VIN-specific key code.

posts.name: ZChat Protocol
posts.tagline: Anonymous P2P Encrypted Chat on Polygon
posts.description: Browser-native peer-to-peer encrypted messaging terminal and non-custodial smart contract escrow on Polygon PoS. Zero registration, sovereign communication.

posts.name: DePayLink
posts.tagline: Accept SOL & USDC on Solana with a simple payment link.
posts.description: DePayLink is a non-custodial crypto payment-link platform built on Solana. Businesses and independent professionals use it to create payment links for products and services, share them with customers, and receive SOL or USDC directly in their own Solana wallet. It removes the need to build and maintain your own payment interface and blockchain verification. DePayLink is not a card processor, bank, custodial wallet, exchange or fiat payment gateway.
